messages:
sophia: Hey team — heads up: new manager in infra is ready to submit a batch of 3 promos (two IC -> Sr IC, one Sr IC -> Staff). They asked for the fastest path to get changes live before EOY. Quick Qs below.

mike: Congrats! Can you confirm if any of these are international? that affects payroll lead times.

sophia: Yes — one is EMEA (London), two US. All role/title mappings already discussed.

elaine: For US promos, if we want effective date 12/01 and retro pay, payroll cutoff is 11/15 for December run. If retro > 30 days we need business approval and finance sign-off.

jonah: What about Greenhouse/GCS steps? Do we need a change record or off-cycle requisition?

people-ops: Quick checklist: 1) Manager fills promo packet (evidence + impact) 2) Submit in Greenhouse role change form with requested effective date 3) Upload compensation change sheet to /shared/comp_changes 4) Tag people-ops and payroll in the ticket.

sophia: Evidence packet — manager asked for an example. Can we share the minimal template here?

elaine: Minimal evidence = 3 bullets: scope increase, measurable outcomes (metrics or customer impact), peer/skip feedback excerpt. Example snippet: ```• Led infra sharding project reducing latency by 28% • Mentored 4 engineers; promoted 2 • Positive skip-level feedback: "consistently drives technical strategy"```

mike: For the EMEA promo: note currency conversion and statutory payroll windows. If effective 12/01, we need local payroll approval by 11/01 to include in December. Otherwise it lands in Jan.

jonah: One more systems question: do we need to mark the hire record as "comp change" in HRIS or will GH sync handle it?

payroll-bot: If Greenhouse change is completed and comp_change spreadsheet is attached, HRIS team will pick it up within 2 business days. Use tag `#hris-pickup` on the GH form.

elaine: Action items: Sophia to collect three evidence docs by 11/03; Mike to confirm finance budget approval for retro through 11/07; Jonah to add GH forms and tag #hris-pickup when uploaded. If any of these miss deadlines we default effective date to 01/01. :calendar: 

sophia: Got it — I'll consolidate and ping here once uploaded. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
